Name: Epic Astropod

Description.name: Epic Astropod
Description.description: The days during which the stars of Poison's Mark hang in the sky remind many of their first interactions with the iconic Celestials. The Wubbox assuredly had 'space on the brain' when the Epic Astropod's design was conceived, but you can't argue that the Wublin's name has never been more fitting than for this ultimate evolved form.

Combinations to Breed: Zap The Eggs Needed To Fill Epic Astropod
